args.goal: Check mission history first and reuse any current equivalent search. Using free public sources, inspect at most three current maintainer-authored fixed-price tasks for documentation, tutorials or non-sensitive data examples. Limit the search to explicitly priced, standalone work. Exclude security, vulnerability reproduction and exploit work. For one fit, verify the original task, exact acceptance criteria, contributor and disclosed-AI rules, and an authorized submission and payout path before creating a task-specific sample. Execute any commands the sample documents and save the actual results with a copy-ready operator handoff. If a prerequisite is unresolved, save the exact source and decision that would reopen that task. Keep offer, submission, acceptance and Treasury settlement separate. No posting, accounts, spending or deployment. Read back evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson.
